title: How to Get Into the Forbidden City: Book 7 Days Ahead | China Travel Expert
description:
Planning Beijing? The Forbidden City is one of the easiest big sights to miss out on, because you can only get in with a ticket booked online in advance.

The Palace Museum sells tickets online only, and each day's tickets open exactly seven days in advance at 8:00 PM Beijing time. On busy dates they can sell out quickly, and the museum is closed on Mondays (except public holidays). Planning ahead is the whole game.

🧭 Expert Tip: book at 8:00 PM Beijing time, seven days before your visit, and have your passport handy — overseas visitors book with the same passport they bring to the entrance.

故宫的票只在网上提前 7 天、晚上 8 点放出，热门日期很快售罄，周一闭馆。提前规划最重要。
